info.description: BMD-45: Bengaluru Mobility Dataset. A large-scale vehicle detection dataset of 45,986 high-resolution (1920x1080) frames from 3,679 operational CCTV cameras in Bengaluru, India. Contains 481,947 bounding-box annotations across 14 fine-grained vehicle classes. Submitted to CVPR 2026 Dataset Track.
